title: Every Local Business in Innlandet, One Map | vitalii.no
description:
Finding and tracking which local businesses in Hamar, Lillehammer, Gjøvik, Ringsaker, Østre Toten and Vestre Toten had been contacted, which had replied, and which still needed a sample meant juggling spreadsheets with no real sense of where any business actually stood.

research/fetch_brreg.mjs, osm_enrich.mjs and geocode.mjs now pull business records from Norway's business registry and OpenStreetMap; select.mjs and build_data.mjs assemble them into a single dataset that server.mjs serves to a Leaflet map in the browser, where every business shows up as a pin colored by its outreach status — a hollow pin marks an approximate, city-center-only location. A systemd timer re-checks business state in the background, and the server exposes an email queue so a first sample can be sent and tracked per business.

Every business in the six target towns now has one pin on one map with a status color instead of a spreadsheet row, and outreach emails queue and get tracked automatically instead of being sent and forgotten.
